summary: The article accurately describes the UPI-linked credit initiative, its purpose, and how it functions, aligning well with information from authoritative sources.

claims.claim: NPCI CEO Dilip Asbe has been highlighting a new initiative called 'UPI-linked Credit'.
claims.note: Dilip Asbe, MD & CEO of NPCI, has indeed been discussing the future of UPI, with credit being a key aspect of its growth.

claims.claim: Mr. Dilip Asbe, the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)
claims.note: Dilip Asbe is the Managing Director and CEO of NPCI.

claims.claim: NPCI is the organisation behind popular digital payment systems like UPI, RuPay, and IMPS.
claims.note: NPCI operates retail payment and settlement systems in India, including UPI, RuPay, and IMPS.

claims.claim: While the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) had earlier laid out a framework for pre-sanctioned credit lines through UPI
claims.note: RBI issued a notification on September 4, 2023, allowing pre-sanctioned credit lines at banks through UPI, following an announcement on April 6, 2023.

claims.claim: NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India): This is an umbrella organisation set up by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and Indian Banks' Association (IBA) to operate retail payments and settlement systems in India.
claims.note: NPCI was established by the RBI and IBA to operate retail payments and settlement systems in India.
